// diagnostic

E0767

A label was written for a positional-only parameter, declared before `/` (D-APILABEL1)

What

A label was written for a positional-only parameter, declared before `/` (D-APILABEL1)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0767

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0767: tests/ui/arg_label_forbidden.stderr.

Error [E0767]: `host` is a positional-only parameter of `connect`
  --> tests/ui/arg_label_forbidden.jet:3:25
    |
  3 | fn run() { _ :: connect(host: "db.internal", timeout: 5) }
    |                         ^^^^
 Why: the `/` in the declaration keeps these parameters positional, so their names stay free to change
 Fix: drop the `host:` label and pass the value by position
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0767
